description: AbstractJsonNumber.java defines an abstract base class for JSON numeric types, providing common functionality for handling various number representations within a JSON processing library.

classes.name: AbstractJsonNumber
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for JSON number types, differentiating numeric representations and conversions, with type safety and validation.

methods.name: AbstractJsonNumber
methods.description: Constructor initializing the numeric value, ensuring it is non-null.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Indicates that this value is a number; always returns true.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Indicates if the number is an integer; default is false, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the number as an int if applicable; throws NumberFormatException otherwise.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Indicates if the number is a long; default is false, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the number as a long if applicable; throws NumberFormatException otherwise.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Indicates if the number is a double; always returns true.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the number as a double.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the numeric value.
